glosses: To write or draw carelessly and in a hurry.

examples.text: I suddenly remembered I needed to buy bleach, so scribbled it down on my shopping list.

glosses: To write badly; to work as an inferior author or journalist.
Careless, hasty writing, doodle or drawing
To card or tease (wool) coarsely; to run through a scribbler.
A hastily or carelessly written note etc.
A broken branch of a tree.
To write something hastily or illegibly.

examples.text: She scrawled the main points onto her notepad.

glosses: To write in an irregular or illegible manner.

examples.text:
c. 1710-1730, Jonathan Swift (probably), Sandys's Ghost
Though with a golden pen you scrawl.

glosses: To creep; crawl; to move slowly, with difficulty, fearfully, or stealthily.

examples.text: we will scrape and scrawl, and catch and pull to us all that we may get
When I saw him scrawlen on the plain, My heart aw flacker'd for't, I was sae fain.
T'poor pig what had just scrawled through t'bottom o' t'cart,
'Cut its throat,' I calls to him, but he didn't, just slashes its forepaw; but it dropt di-rekly, couldn't hardly scrawl out on the bank.'

glosses: Écrire, dessiner ou peindre quelque chose d’une manière confuse et informe.

examples.text: Gribouiller, faire mes pages, c'étaient là de saines formules, m'épargnant toute exaltation.
Le téléphone sonna trois fois et Max parla longuement, en fumant. Il gribouillait sur une feuille de papier près de l'appareil.
Il plia la feuille, l'introduisit dans une enveloppe sur laquelle il gribouilla le nom et l'adresse de son ami. Il examina quelques secondes la suscription difficilement lisible […].
On découvre des acteurs qui signent des tribunes sans réfléchir, comme ils gribouillent des autographes avant de monter les marches du Festival de Cannes, […].

glosses: etwas in kurzer Zeit und mit schlechter Qualität schreiben, malen oder zeichnen

examples.text: Was hast du denn auf dieses Blatt gekritzelt?
Er kritzelte eine Nachricht an seine Tür.
„Sie kritzelten auf ihre Schiefertafeln in der Schule die Umrisse von Flugzeugen, die Stukas oder Messerschmitt hießen.“
